_comment: Starter dispatch policy, modelled on an off-grid site still under construction:
the only permanent loads are the comms gear and the system's own parasitic.
Builder loads are transient and unswitched, so they are an advisory device with
no switch. Replace it with your own devices and list.
Grow this toward the simulator's defaults as circuits are energised.
Calibration for the original site (Selectronic portal, 4 days):
standby 0.108 kW = the stable Solar Generation MINUS Energy Usage gap (~2.5 kWh/d),
which is upstream of the load meter and never appears in Energy Usage.
network 0.05 kW ~= the 1.2 kWh/d measured on 09-30 (router + switch + PoE + select.live2).
builders: the 09-30 -> 10-01 step was ~1.4 kWh/d. Modelled as a 1 kW nameplate at a 0.17
duty factor over a 9 h working day = ~1.5 kWh/d, rather than 1 kW continuous.
